# elicitjs.github.io

The ElicitJS documentation site, live at <https://elicitjs.github.io/>.

**This repository is generated. Do not edit it by hand** — the next deploy
overwrites everything here.

The source lives in [elicitjs/elicitjs-docs](https://github.com/elicitjs/elicitjs-docs).
To publish a change, edit it there and run `npm run deploy:pages`.
`DEPLOY.json` records which source commit produced the current build.
